analysis.intent_details: Notify recipient that meeting transcription is ready and provide access link

responses.subject: Re: Tactiq: Meeting Transcription
responses.body:
Dear Tactiq Team,

Thank you for notifying me that my meeting transcript is ready. I appreciate your service and will review the transcript shortly.

Best regards,
Humbal
responses.rationale: A simple acknowledgment confirms receipt of the notification while maintaining professional courtesy. This is appropriate since the email is informational and doesn't require action.

responses.subject: Re: Tactiq: Meeting Transcription

Dear Tactiq Team,

responses.rationale: This response acknowledges the notification and indicates the next step of reviewing the transcript, showing engagement with the service while maintaining professionalism.
